title: Online food delivery disputes - the consumer remedies available
p1:
A missing item in your food order may feel like a small inconvenience. But did you know it can also become a consumer rights issue?

Many people assume that once they complain to the delivery app, their only option is to accept a refund decision.
p2:
The surprising part is that online food delivery platforms, restaurants, and delivery partners can all have different responsibilities depending on the problem.

A wrong order, poor quality food, hidden charges, or a service failure may amount to a deficiency in service under consumer protection laws.
p3:
Consumers can first raise a complaint with the platform or restaurant and keep records like order details, payment proof, photos, and chat conversations.

If the issue remains unresolved, a consumer complaint may be an option depending on the facts of the case. Keeping evidence is often what makes a complaint stronger.
conclusion: Have you ever faced a food delivery dispute where the platform refused to help? What was your experience?
